name: openrouter-analytics-mcp
description: Third-party OpenRouter workbench for personal usage analysis, saved reports, cost experiments and routing preset export. Self-hosted owner-private service required.

interface.shortDescription: 费用分析、异常提醒与模型方案
interface.longDescription: 由 cyuanxv 维护的第三方开源工作台，非 OpenRouter 官方产品。支持余额与费用查询、异常分析、保存报告、成本实验及模型预设导出。当前分析服务仅支持个人自行部署；不提供公众共享账单服务，不执行付费推理或自动切换业务模型。OpenRouter 官方 MCP 是独立服务，权限另行确认。
defaultPrompt: How much did I spend on OpenRouter yesterday, and what drove the cost?
Analyze my last 30 days of OpenRouter usage and find cost optimization opportunities.
Compare these OpenRouter models by live price, context, providers, and benchmark evidence.

publication.release_notes: 0.5.0: personal reports, anomaly attribution, cost experiments and versioned routing presets. Public release preparation only; hosted public access is not available.
